thread:
Priya Nair: FYI the onboarding checklist references an internal curl example that 404s (staging only). I ran the preview and it errors out for newbies.
Ben Gomez: thanks for flagging. which file?
Priya Nair: content/kb/onboarding/quickstart.md line ~120. the curl target is /api/v1/runtime/health -> staging returns 404.
Riley Fox: I can take a quick look later today. might be a staging routing config, not the doc.
DocsBot: Link scan result: staging-only 404 at /api/v1/runtime/health detected on 2025-01-08.
Ben Gomez: If it's config, we should avoid changing the doc to point to prod; better to fix staging. I'll add a short debug note in the PR if Riley wants to patch the doc temporarily.
Maya Singh: tagging infra-oncall; can someone from eng-infra validate the staging route? @eng-infra
Riley Fox: quick update 44b dug in and confirmed staging reverse-proxy had a missing rule. filed RW-2289 for infra to apply a small fix.
Priya Nair: thanks Riley. leaving a TODO in the doc to note "staging endpoint temporarily unavailable" until RW-2289 is handled.
Ben Gomez: made a tiny edit branch + PR that adds a one-line note and a TODO with the RW ticket number. link: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/8389
Riley Fox: reviewed and approved.
DocsBot: PR #8389 merged by Ben Gomez at 2025-01-08T21:03:12Z. RW-2289 workitem assigned to eng-infra.
Maya Singh: infra team acked RW-2289, ETA tomorrow morning. will post update here once deployed.
Ben Gomez: great, thanks everyone.
Priya Nair: leaving this thread; will check after infra deploy and remove the TODO once staging route is healthy.
